about_the_game:
Don't Touch Us - Demo

Step into the nightmare with this exclusive first look at Don't Touch Us. This demo lets you experience the first level of the full game, immersing you in the decaying halls of the abandoned Doctor’s Hospital, where shadows whisper, and the walls remember everything.

As one half of Anya’s lost spirit, you awaken to a haunting presence calling your name. Explore the hospital’s eerie corridors, solve puzzles, and uncover the first pieces of the horrifying mystery that binds you to this place. But beware—the doctor still lingers… and he’s watching.

🔹 Experience the game’s atmospheric horror and environmental storytelling.
🔹 Solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets in the hospital’s ruined halls.
🔹 Feel the dread of psychological horror, with no combat—only fear.

This is just the beginning. The full game will expand upon every element—more scares, more story, and even more refinements to this very level. Expect improvements in visuals, mechanics, and immersion before launch.

Try the demo now, and wishlist the full game to prepare for the horrors that await in Q2 2025.

content_descriptors.notes:
Our game is a psychological horror experience featuring intense and graphic depictions of violence, gore, and disturbing imagery. Players will encounter scenes of extreme bloodshed, mutilated bodies, and unsettling environments designed to create a deeply immersive and terrifying atmosphere. The game includes dismemberment, torture, and other violent acts that may be disturbing to sensitive players.

While there are no depictions of sexual acts or sexual assault, the game explores dark themes such as psychological torment, insanity, and the fragility of the human mind. Some scenes may involve self-harm, distressing hallucinations, and references to traumatic experiences.

This game is intended for mature audiences only and is not suitable for players who may be sensitive to extreme violence or horror elements. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Vega 8 / Intel UHD Graphic 630
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for an immersive experience

Experience immersive horror with no combat—just fear, tension, and haunting discoveries. Try the first level now and wishlist the full game for its Q2 2025 release.
